# EV ChargeHub

> India's smart EV charging booking platform — find nearby stations, reserve a slot, and skip the queue.

EV ChargeHub helps EV drivers in India discover live charging stations on an interactive map, reserve a bay in seconds, and pay securely. Premium subscribers get priority slots and longer reservations.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of EV ChargeHub, features, and pricing.
- [Sign in](/auth): Sign in or create an EV ChargeHub account.
